about: Our own tiledata and animdata records (cc-P26, F-8), and our worn-item animations (cc-P62, F-35). Nothing here is copied from EA's files: every value is ours, and the tiledata values follow OSI's animated runestone 0xADBA 'Runestone01 Glow01' and OSI's earrings 0x1087 (flags, weight, layer and height read from the client's tiledata.mul; see SOURCE.txt). app\Play.ps1 writes the tiledata and animdata records into copies of the player's own tiledata.mul and animdata.mul, and gives each equipAnims body a Bodyconv.def line, in a copy of the player's own Bodyconv.def, that sends it to slot 'slot' of app\sl-anim7.bin (scripts\build-equip-anims.py). Change only together with registry.csv.
